item.title: Elon Musk Plays Down G.O.P. Support After Midterm Loss

item.title: Watch: Hailey Bieber Says Social Media Has Affected Her Mental Health
item.description: The model and entrepreneur, who last year sold her Rhode beauty brand for some $800 million, said in an interview at the DealBook Summit that online comments can be “distorting to the mind.”

item.title: A.I. Makes More Tech Outages Likely, Microsoft’s Chief Warns
item.description: Satya Nadella said that A.I. tools were finding cybersecurity bugs at a breakneck pace, and that companies were having to create fixes and deploy them “instantaneously.”
item.dc:creator: Karen Weise
item.media:credit: Adam Gray/Getty Images for The New York Times
item.media:description: Satya Nadella, right, Microsoft’s chief executive, said tech companies had less time to test patches, which could lead to buggy updates.

item.title: Watch: Zohran Mamdani on Finding Common Ground With Trump
item.description: The mayor of New York also stood by his positions on Israel and Gaza. “I have a politics of universality,” he said in a wide-ranging interview at the DealBook Summit.
item.media:credit: Shuran Huang for The New York Times
